syndromes.title: Candidaemia / invasive candidiasis — genus-level approach
rows: ANID 200 mg LD→100 mg/day; CASPO 70 mg LD→50 mg/day (70 mg/day if >80 kg per source); MICA 100 mg/day; REZA 400 mg LD→200 mg weekly
For uncomplicated candidaemia: minimum 14 days after bloodstream clearance AND symptom resolution
Apply only if clinically invasive Candida infection is present; confirm susceptibility where possible
A I at Candida-genus level; not species-specific evidence
Cornely 2025 Candidiasis | genus-level candidaemia treatment (Table 29 / Fig 11–13, PDF pp93–100); taxonomy: Supplement Table 1, PDF p14
Use AFST and species-specific susceptibility data to refine therapy
The guideline's taxonomy table includes this taxon, but no independent species-specific treatment recommendation was identified in the audited source.
